bugs.description: Off-by-one full threshold (count == DEPTH+1): a 9th enqueue is accepted, overflowing the FIFO. Needs 8 back-to-back enqueues to expose.
Simultaneous enqueue+dequeue race: if/else priority drops the dequeue, double-counting occupancy and breaking pointer/count consistency.

description: Depth-8 synchronous FIFO with explicit count (style of Sparkle/Library/Queue SyncFIFO); asserts no overflow/underflow, pointer/count consistency, and empty/full gating.
